title: Dev Research Engineer
description:
Dev Research Engineer
Peoria, IL
Onsite

Scope of the Role

The e-Powertrain Validation Planning Support Engineer works closely with the e-Powertrain (ePt) system design team to ensure technical risks are identified, prioritized, and mitigated for each ePt configuration. The role's scope includes:

  • Risk Management: Collect risks identified in DFMEAs, sort them by RPN (Risk Priority Number = likelihood × severity), and help identify simulation or physical test activities (bench, lab, full machine) to mitigate those risks within cost and time constraints.
  • Validation Planning: Develop and refine validation plans, balancing technical risk reduction with program timelines and budgets.
  • System Readiness: Gather readiness summaries from component and subsystem teams.
  • Reporting: Create concise validation status slides for NPI Gateway reviews.
  • Issue Management: Maintain and manage issue lists for various ePt programs.
  • Forecasting: Forecast defects per unit and create proactive reliability curves to predict system performance and durability over product life.
  • Collaboration: Work in an office environment, collaborating with local and global teams. The validation team includes 2–3 experienced engineers who will guide the individual.

Required Skills

Top 3 Skills

  1. Technical Communication: Ability to understand detailed engineering discussions and translate them into common language for broader audiences.
  2. Project Management Forecasting: Ability to estimate duration and resource needs for test activities, including instrumentation and logistics.
  3. Collaboration & Learning: Ability to listen to and learn from more experienced engineers, and willingness to implement their suggestions.

Technical Skills

  • Hands-on Test Experience: Required for fuel systems, engines, full machines, or vehicles. Desired for electric drivetrain systems.
  • DFMEA/FMEA Knowledge: Ability to interpret and act on risk assessments.
  • Validation Planning: Experience in planning and executing validation activities, including simulation and physical testing.
  • System Integration: Understanding of how subsystems interact within the e-powertrain configuration.

title: Teamcenter data migration
description:
Teamcenter data migration
Remote

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Teamcenter Data Migration Engineer to lead and execute end-to-end data migration activities between legacy PLM systems and Siemens Teamcenter.   • Experience with Teamcenter import/export utilities, PLM XML, TcDataFileImport, SOA, and ITK customization.
  • Proficiency in SQL, scripting languages (Perl, Python, Shell, or PowerShell) for ETL and automation.
  • Familiarity with Teamcenter versions (10.x, 11.x, 12.x, or Active Workspace).
  • Experience with CAD data migration (NX, CATIA, Pro/E, SolidWorks) is a plus.
